planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and wiring is preserved: D2 is the pause/resume button using INPUT_PULLUP (pressed = LOW -> model true), D6 is the passive buzzer driven via tone output.

Time-dependent beeping, initial silent state, first beep after accumulated 3000ms, then every 3000ms, with 100ms on-time at 1000Hz and 20ms tolerance, plus pause/resume behavior with preserved accumulated timing and remaining on-time, are implemented in the SysML model using elapsed_ms; no timers/conditions/durations are placed in device requests.
The application requires an elapsed_ms input; it is provided here as the standard program-owned delta since previous control step with initial=0.
Pause must immediately silence the buzzer but keep remaining beeping time and accumulated schedule so that resuming continues mid-cycle rather than restarting the full period.
D6 starts silent (tone_output initial 0) per requirement: initial running but muted.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Pause/Resume pushbutton (INPUT_PULLUP). Model true at LOW (pressed).

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Passive buzzer tone; model controls frequency. 1000Hz when beeping.

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
蜂鸣器（D6）每 3 秒响一次，按钮（D2）暂停/恢复
验收约定：D6使用无源蜂鸣器，音调1000Hz，每次持续100ms；初始运行且静音，累计运行3000ms后首次发声，此后每累计运行3000ms开始一次。D2使用INPUT_PULLUP，低电平按下沿切换暂停/恢复，长按及松开不切换。暂停立即静音，保留计时和剩余鸣叫时长，恢复后继续，不能重新开始完整周期。响应及鸣叫时间容差20ms。
